data.gender_notes: Kane is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Kanēs, meaning 'warrior' or 'I sing'. In Greek mythology, Canēs was a hero who killed the monster Hydra, demonstrating bravery and strength. The name Kane carries the meaning “Warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kane usually hope their child will grow to embody warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kane total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
